workflows.title: 30-Day Viral Vault
workflows.summary: Plan 30 days, prepare six rights-cleared posts daily, and review exactly one post at a time before an approved schedule or local handoff.
triggers: set up my 30-day viral vault
prepare my six daily posts one at a time
show my next Viral Vault post

inputs.name: verified creator setup and six eligible daily sources

outputs.name: 30-day blueprint and sequential daily review packet

workflows.title: AI Content Forensics
workflows.summary: Reverse-engineer an inspectable creator corpus into evidence-linked content rules, copyable templates, and one verified ten-post thread without predicting performance.
triggers: run AI Content Forensics
reverse-engineer this creator's content
turn this creator corpus into copyable templates

inputs.name: bounded local or connected creator corpus and evidence-linked finding candidates

outputs.name: constitutions, insight audit, exact ten-post thread, optional visuals, and body-free receipt

workflows.title: Agree the Next Step
workflows.summary: Turn current conversation evidence into one explicit next step with exact text, owner approval and separate recipient permission.
triggers: agree the next step with this buyer
prepare one clear next step from this conversation

workflows.title: Anti-Spam Lead Desk
workflows.summary: Review bounded owned-post comments, classify up to five candidates across three lanes, and persist one exact public-reply draft for owner review.
triggers: review my warm Threads comments
build an anti-spam lead desk

inputs.name: verified account, confirmed offer, and current public evidence

outputs.name: five-card lead desk and one unsent review action

workflows.title: Buyer Questions to Content
workflows.summary: Turn deidentified buyer questions into a local content candidate while preserving whether evidence is single or repeated.
triggers: turn buyer questions into content
draft a post from these deidentified questions

workflows.title: Choose Your First Offer
workflows.summary: Compare an intensive, lab, and kit with one evidence-bound scorecard and choose the fastest truthful offer hypothesis to validate.
triggers: choose my first offer
compare an intensive, cohort, and digital product
what should I sell first

inputs.name: confirmed audience, constraints, and evidence summary

outputs.name: offer decision and Proof Loop Map

workflows.title: Content Brain Repair
workflows.summary: Public orchestration for Content Brain Repair, with review, exact approval and readback.
triggers: repair my Content Brain
compare content before and after a Brain repair

workflows.title: Create My Day
workflows.summary: Prepare one through five source-backed posts with exact daily review; five is the default.
triggers: create my day
prepare today's Threads posts

workflows.title: Create My Month
workflows.summary: Plan 28 days, visibly four weeks, with rolling drafts by default or all drafts upfront.
triggers: create my month
plan four weeks of Threads content

workflows.title: Create My Week
workflows.summary: Plan seven days with rolling drafts by default or all drafts upfront, preserving daily review and continuation.
triggers: create my week
plan seven days of Threads content

workflows.title: Cross-post To X After Threads
workflows.summary: Read a Threads schedule or publish status and prepare an X-ready fallback artifact. Live X execution is not part of public v0.
triggers: cross-post my Threads post to X
prepare an X-ready follow-up

workflows.title: Daily Greatest Hits
workflows.summary: Use a user-approved greatest-hits source pack or basic greatest-hits readback, prepare daily post candidates and optional proof/use-case lanes, validate approved copy, schedule only after explicit approval, and return receipts.
triggers: use my greatest hits for today's posts
prepare daily candidates from a greatest-hits source pack

workflows.title: Daily Posts Heartbeat
workflows.summary: Validate approved daily post copy, schedule it through Threadify MCP after explicit approval, read back status, and capture feedback.
triggers: schedule my approved daily posts
run my daily posts heartbeat

workflows.title: Find Your Niche
workflows.summary: Use owned Threads posts and conversations to recommend one evidence-backed niche, one ideal-client avatar and a private saveable report.
triggers: find my niche from my Threads data
use my best Threads posts and comments to find my niche

workflows.title: Follow Through
workflows.summary: Track explicit promises and dates from buyer conversations until a truthful terminal outcome is recorded.
triggers: show what I promised buyers
follow through on dated buyer commitments

workflows.title: Greatest Hits Runway
workflows.summary: Public orchestration for Greatest Hits Runway, with review, exact approval and readback.
triggers: prepare my greatest hits runway
review a seven-day runway of proven posts

workflows.title: Market to Pipeline
workflows.summary: Turn one offer and one bounded market into a private qualified pipeline, exact permission-aware actions, seven de-identified posts, and body-free receipts using normalized Threadify and optional Treg evidence.
triggers: turn this market into a qualified pipeline
run Market to Pipeline with Threadify and Treg
find permission-aware leads and build seven posts

inputs.name: one versioned offer, one bounded market, normalized Threadify and optional Treg evidence

outputs.name: private pipeline, exact actions, seven-post campaign, action lifecycle, and body-free receipts

workflows.title: Personal Brain Sync / Current Self Packet
workflows.summary: Turn an approved personal context packet into small, classified, approval-gated Threadify Brain memories with readback proof and a per-item ledger.
triggers: sync my current self to Threadify Brain
review personal context before saving memories

workflows.title: Post This Next
workflows.summary: Review every eligible Threadify draft and recommend the next draft to finish for usefulness, owned engagement-pattern fit, or readiness without predicting performance.
triggers: post this next
choose my next Threadify draft
review every draft and tell me what to finish next

inputs.name: complete eligible draft snapshot and normalized decision evaluations

workflows.title: Qualified Buyer Research
workflows.summary: Map the user's offer and voice, search persistently within a hard cap, qualify situation and outcome fit, stage one offer-free reply, stop before send, and learn separately from candidate and message outcomes.
triggers: find qualified buyers on Threads
research buyer language and stage one reply

workflows.title: Refresh Your Threads Profile
workflows.summary: Interview a creator and turn their niche and approved context into three coherent bio-and-profile-picture systems with a safe review-and-apply path.
triggers: refresh my Threads bio and profile picture
redesign my Threads profile from my niche
help me safely apply a new Threads profile

workflows.title: Threadify Inbound Replies
workflows.summary: Review Threads inbound grouped beneath its source post, preserve exact edits locally, and use only a currently advertised Threadify delivery capability for an explicitly approved reply set.
triggers: review my Threads reply backlog
use Threadify inbound replies

workflows.title: Threadify Offer Builder
workflows.summary: An adaptive offer interview, local HTML page and optional approved CTA Studio save.
triggers: build my offer
interview me and make an offer page

workflows.title: Viral Carousel Maker
workflows.summary: Create and review a seven-edit controlled-mutation carousel locally with the bundled Viral Carousel Maker v0.2.0, then optionally upload its exact ordered media and schedule it through two separate approval gates.
triggers: make a viral carousel
create and review a controlled-mutation carousel

workflows.title: Viral Vault Setup
workflows.summary: Review 10–20 selected Threads/YouTube sources plus a small shared selection before any import; fewer strong sources may proceed with gaps.
triggers: set up my Viral Vault
build a starter inspiration Vault

workflows.title: Weekly Buyer Outcomes
workflows.summary: Review the past seven days of buyer actions and commitments while separating owner-reported results from provider-observed evidence.
triggers: review my buyer outcomes for the past seven days
show this week's provider-observed and owner-reported buyer results

workflows.title: Weekly Winner Replication
workflows.summary: Use basic greatest-hits readback where available, prepare an approved replication schedule, and keep advanced analytics strategy paid-gated.
triggers: replicate this week's winners
prepare transformed drafts from recent winning posts

workflows.title: X Article From Daily Post
workflows.summary: Turn an approved daily post into a draft-only, bookmark-optimized X Article packet with thumbnail brief, scorecard, manual review gate, and receipt. Live X execution is not part of public v0.
triggers: turn my daily post into an X Article
prepare a draft-only X Article packet

workflows.title: YouTube Edit (Eddy)
workflows.summary: Drive a verified local Eddy engine to produce a YouTube launch kit, then optionally prepare and schedule Threadify promotional posts after explicit final approval. Inspect actual output assets; do not permit unapproved source-media transfers or publishing.
triggers: edit my YouTube video
prepare an edit plan and Threadify promo posts

workflows.title: Your Next Moves
workflows.summary: Use a confirmed offer and supplied conversation evidence to prepare up to three supported actions for one-at-a-time review.
triggers: show my next buyer moves
review these conversations against my offer
